caption: The drawing shows two views of a blue bonnet or cap with ribbons and ruffled edges, centrally positioned on the page. The bonnet features a blue fabric decorated with small red and white flowers and solid blue ribbons that hang down on each side, with a ruffled greenish trim along some edges. Surrounding the bonnet are eight square fabric swatches, four on each side, arranged in two vertical columns. The swatches display a range of patterns and textures: the top left shows a blue background with red and white floral motifs; the middle left has a solid light blue, diagonally striped design; the bottom left displays a purple fabric dotted with white and pink accents; and the bottom right swatch is a dark blue with small reddish motifs. On the right side, the top swatch is a purple fabric with a dense, small circular pattern; the second from the top shows a vertical green and white striped design; the third is a blue with a subtle diagonal pattern; and the bottom right is another blue swatch decorated with small red motifs. Each swatch is labeled with fine text indicating material, weave, or pattern. The drawing uses primarily blue, green, purple, white, and red, and is bordered by a thin dark line with annotations, including a signature and date in the lower right corner.
title: Economy: Detail of Cloth and Bonnet
